# ChugChug

> ChugChug（吨吨吨） is an iOS-only party drinking-game app. Rules and props are built in. It plays offline, has no ads, and does not require an account.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/chugchug-party-game/id6758532049

The app is iOS only. There is no Android version.

## Pages

- [English home](https://chugchug.app/): product overview, screenshots, and the 15 games.
- [简体中文](https://chugchug.app/zh/): 吨吨吨首页。
- [繁體中文](https://chugchug.app/zh-Hant/): 繁體中文首頁。
- [Privacy policy](https://chugchug.app/privacy.html): local play, no account, no personal data collection.
- [隐私政策](https://chugchug.app/zh/privacy.html)

## Games

- Dice: Hold to roll for a number, an order, or a penalty
- Undercover: Deception and deduction to hunt down the outsider
- Playing Cards: Universal standard deck ready for any drinking rules
- Chug Cards: Rapid-fire cards with instant social penalties
- Six Ones: Fast roll-off: clear your dice or pass them on
- Lucky: Press, roll, match poker dice, and turn the tables
- Perudo: Roll, bid in turn, and decide when to call the bluff
- Truth or Dare: Spicy confessions and daring feats to break the ice
- Finger Picker: Multi-touch finger picker to select the next player
- King's Game: The King commands, everyone else must obey
- Heads Up: Timed acting and hilarious high-energy guessing
- Most Likely To: Count down and point: most votes takes the penalty
- Wavelength: Tune into the exact same mental frequency
- 36 Questions: Aron’s 36 questions to connect on a deeper level
- Angry Old Man: Tense turn-taking: poke the board without getting caught
